name: Roomy bases
description: A data-only mod: at least 6 Flame Altars from the first Flame level and 2 more than the game allows at every level (at most 16), build zones at 150% of the game's, and a 64 m zone for a new altar. blocks/bases.json, no code. Kiln's base rules: no game names, and no conflict with another mod's base rules.
